# Smart VAT Kenya

> Professional VAT registration and monthly iTax filing for Kenyan SMEs. 
> Flat fees, M-PESA accepted, WhatsApp support. Based in Nairobi, Kenya.

## What We Do

- **VAT Registration** — KES 5,000 flat fee, completed in 1–3 working days via the KRA iTax portal (we handle the portal; you never touch it).
- **Monthly VAT Filing** — KES 3,500/month, filed on the 17th (before the 20th KRA deadline).
- **KRA Penalty Waiver Applications** — KES 4,000 per application, drafted and submitted to KRA on your behalf.
- **Free Tools** — Kenya VAT Calculator, Penalty Waiver Wizard, iTax Error Diagnosis, VAT Registration Quiz.

## Kenya VAT Facts (verified 2026-08-08 against KRA guidance and the Tax Procedures Act)

- Standard rate: 16% (VAT Act, Cap. 476).
- Mandatory registration threshold: KES 5,000,000 annual taxable turnover — KRA official guidance applies KES 5M (verified 2026-08-08); an increase to KES 8M has been reported via Finance Act 2025 commentary. See our explainer: /resources/kra-portal-vs-service/
- Voluntary registration: from KES 5 million.
- Filing deadline: 20th of the following month (nil returns included).
- Late filing penalty: higher of KES 10,000 or 5% of tax due, plus 1% monthly interest.
- Late payment penalty: 5% of unpaid tax plus 1% monthly interest.
- Non-registration penalty: KES 100,000 per month (TPA s.95).
- eTIMS non-compliance: 2x tax due, with Finance Act 2026 minimums of KES 100,000 (companies) / KES 10,000 (individuals).
- eTIMS integration failure: up to KES 100,000 per month, capped at KES 1,000,000 (TPA s.59A(5)).
- Zero-rated (0%): exports, basic foodstuffs, medical equipment, water.
- Exempt: financial services, insurance, education.
- VAT refund claims: within 12 months.
- eTIMS is mandatory for all VAT-registered businesses; since January 2026 KRA validates returns against eTIMS data.
